messages:
jamie: Newcrest POC kickoff — customer needs SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain controls, and clear pricing. Timeline: demo by next Wed. @maria can you own the presales checklist and coord?

maria: Yep, I can take point. Quick Q: do we have a template for SCIM attribute mappings to share? I also need their IdP metadata and whether they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated SSO.

alex: We support both SP and IdP initiated flows. For SAML we usually ask for: entityID, ACS URL, certificate (X.509) and NameID format. Example config snippet we send to customers:

```
SAML settings:
  entityId: https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs
  acsUrl: https://app.redwood.ai/saml/consume
  nameIdFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
```

alex: Also note: we can pass through groups in the assertion or sync via SCIM — both are common.

maria: For RBAC they want roles synced from IdP groups. Need mapping doc: group -> role -> permissions. Any constraints on group name length / characters?

ian: security-bot: Uploaded Newcrest_SecQ_2026.pdf to the secure folder. Highlights: require SAML signing/encryption support, SCIM should support scoped attributes and delta sync, data retention/NDAs noted. Question IDs: S-12 (SAML cert rotation), P-3 (SCIM attribute minimization), A-7 (RBAC audits).

sam: Pricing question from AE: For a 6-week POC (500 DAU, 200k tokens/day), what is a rough hosted vs dedicated estimate? Also can we offer a short reserved trial for predictable latency?

julian: For SCIM provisioning we support bulk POST, PATCH, and incremental delta via /Users?start= and /Users?since=. Typical rate limit for POC is 60 reqs/min but can be raised for dedicated. Example curl for SCIM PATCH:

```
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/{id} -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","value":{"active":true}}]}'
```

julian: Also flagging that domain controls (claiming domains) require DNS TXT proof of ownership — customers must control DNS for any domains they want tenant-locked.

maria: Great. Next steps: I will send them the SCIM mapping template + SAML metadata request today, upload completed security Q answers by EOD tomorrow, and ask AEs for the usage numbers to firm up pricing. Can @alex and @julian review the SSO/SCIM test plan by 11am PST tomorrow? :thumbsup:

jamie: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll schedule the kickoff call for Tue 10am PT and invite Newcrest and our SRE/SE.

devops-bot: Link to internal POC runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/poc-saml-scim (read-only)

maria: Assigned tasks in the thread, will post updates here. If anyone has got past-case notes or discounts we used for similar finance customers, drop them here.

sam: I'll pull prior POC pricing and post a 1-pager after lunch.

maria: closing loop — thanks :raised_hands:
